name: Gujarat Energy Ltd (formerly Gujarat Gas / GSPC group)
tagline: ~Rs 24,000 Cr integrated gas utility after the May-2026 GSPC-group amalgamation -- decent returns but far too large and too regulated for a multi-bagger thesis
business_overview: Gujarat Energy is the entity created by the May-2026 composite amalgamation of GSPC, Gujarat State Petronet (GSPL) and GSPC Energy: city gas distribution, gas trading, exploration & production, renewables and strategic investments.
fundamentals_narrative: Returns are respectable for a utility (ROCE ~18.5%) and volumes should improve, but this is a large, largely regulated city-gas and gas-transmission business. There is no catalyst capable of producing a multi-fold re-rating from a ~Rs 24,000 Cr base.
sentiment_summary: Not deep-read this pass. Filtered at the preliminary stage: a ~Rs 24,000 Cr regulated gas utility cannot realistically deliver 10x in 2-3 years or 100x in 10 years, and the large-cap recent-inflection carve-out explicitly does not apply at this size.
bull_case: Integrated energy franchise (CGD + transmission + E&P + renewables) with dominant Gujarat presence
Volume growth as industrial and CNG demand recovers
bear_case: ~Rs 24,000 Cr market cap -- a 10x/100x outcome is not realistic
Largely regulated tariffs cap the upside
Amalgamation integration and holding-company structure add complexity
verdict_headline: Solid regulated gas utility, but far too large and too rate-capped for the thesis -- filtered out on size
verdict_reasoning: Size alone rules out a multi-bagger outcome; the large-cap recent-inflection carve-out does not apply
No red flag, no catalyst -> 'neither', conviction Low, no revisit
disclaimer: This is independent research for informational purposes only, not investment advice.

four_box.note: Verdict explicit: 'size alone rules out a multi-bagger outcome; the large-cap recent-inflection carve-out does not apply' (tam=no); no catalyst identified beyond an improving volume outlook.
